scope_definition_process.scope_planning_approach: Iterative product backlog grooming and progressive elaboration with stakeholders.
scope_definition_process.roles_and_responsibilities: Product Owner defines features, Project Manager verifies scope baselines and signoffs.
scope_definition_process.scope_statement_preparation_steps: Facilitate stakeholder discovery sessions, document deliverables, and define acceptance criteria.

wbs_creation_and_structure.wbs_decomposition_methodology: Decompose high-level releases into modular epics, features, and verifiable work packages.
wbs_creation_and_structure.wbs_level_of_detail: Granularity defined to the 8/80 hour rule: work packages span 8 to 80 person-hours.
wbs_creation_and_structure.wbs_identification_scheme: Hierarchical numbering scheme matching lifecycle deliverable codes (e.g. 1.1.2.3).

wbs_dictionary_and_baseline.wbs_dictionary_development: Document detailed work package description, responsible owners, and completion criteria.
wbs_dictionary_and_baseline.scope_baseline_approval_and_maintenance: Formal signoff required by Steering Committee before locking scope baseline in project portal.

scope_verification_and_acceptance.deliverable_verification_process: Peer review and quality checklist audits conducted before initiating customer inspection.
scope_verification_and_acceptance.formal_acceptance_criteria: Acceptance criteria signed off by customer leads on formal deliverable acceptance forms.

scope_control_and_integration.scope_change_control_integration: Any requested variance is routed through formal Change Request Form PMO-06.01 evaluation.
scope_control_and_integration.requirements_traceability_integration: All approved scope work packages trace directly to verified business requirements matrix.
